description4:
Platform for managing Assetto Corsa racing championships (achub.pro). Drivers upload car skins through a web portal or a Discord bot, the platform validates them automatically, and organizers publish straight to the game server. It also handles registration payments.
In production with 18 championships and 100+ registered drivers.
Python, Flask and PostgreSQL with Clean Architecture, 2,000+ automated tests, CI/CD and monitoring.
description1:
Streaming platform: built the content ingestion pipeline from scratch, migrated it from Python to Go (processing went from minutes to seconds per item), and designed a vector-based recommendation system.
Lending company: designing and building a loan management system that replaces a legacy desktop application, with a unified data model over several separate PostgreSQL databases and a server-rendered web interface.
Consulting firm: backend work on an internal document search tool using vector search.
Low-code platform: backend features in TypeScript with Clean Architecture, plus UI/UX testing and basic penetration testing.
